derivation: plural of active participle of H6822 (צָפָה); watchers;
def: Tsophim, a place East of the Jordan

occurrences.text: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
